independentEngine.provenanceWarning: Executed npm source differs from its declared Git SHA in the Xin-year Tiankui/Tianyue entries. evalGround calls evalRuntimeGround, so the differences also affect natal charts. The old 81-field benchmark did not compare those stars. This extended benchmark executes the pinned npm artifact and records this distinction. npm Xin-year Tiankui=午,Tianyue=寅; declared Git source reverses them. Both npm and product use the 马虎 variant; Quanshu's printed 虎马 order differs.
